migrationBehaviour: Legacy SQLite index rename only; preserves all source rows/history; idempotent on already-correct schema; down retains valid short name

testIsolation.native: Private loopback daemon and generated schema/user/marker/token, validated before resets
testIsolation.ddl: Fresh native schema per DB-backed test; no artificial wrapping transaction around DDL
testIsolation.auditFailures: Native SQLite RAISE or MySQL/MariaDB SIGNAL, no skipped cases
testIsolation.http: Same actual request flow and independent connector checks; date preservation compares original source rather than one driver’s storage representation

dependencies: composer.json, lock and all vendor files unchanged from v0.29.0; test-only Python connector PyMySQL 1.1.2
previousEvidence: evidence/v0.29.0-TEST_RESULTS.json; dependency/S3/TLS evidence retains historical scope
limits: Native engine verified is local MariaDB 11.8.6/InnoDB through PDO MySQL, not Oracle MySQL or Martin’s actual managed Cloud version. Actual engine/version/collation/TLS, schema mapping and staging acceptance remain necessary.

The source corrects the old fresh-create index name and adds a forward normaliser for older SQLite checkpoints. An earlier FAILED native migration may have partially committed tables; inspect and reconcile that state before retrying. No unknown existing schema is automatically dropped/repaired.

Native tests use their own disposable loopback daemon, private credentials/marker and fresh schema per database test. The normal test path refuses non-testing or non-memory SQLite targets. This is not permission to reset an existing staging/live portal.

Native audit failures use real SIGNAL errors and the two-process first-admin race produced one account/audit/marker. This does not certify every concurrency path, target load, backup/restore or platform failure mode.

Both actual loopback HTTP suites check saved module rows/file hashes across PHP restart. These are fictional local requests, not browser/mobile/keyboard acceptance or Cloud redeployment/private bucket verification.

The clean no-dev build is local supplied-lock install/package discovery and Laravel caches. Dependencies and source PDFs are unchanged from v0.29.0; earlier S3 wire/audit evidence retains its recorded historical scope.

No existing/live database, real learner data, real credentials, external messages or actual Cloud connection/deployment used. Staging/bootstrap/scheduling remain opt-in and off by default; production access stays blocked.
Actual repository/identity migration, legacy evidence rescue/migration, private storage, employer sharing, whole-history compliance and curriculum/gateway/funding decisions remain separate.
